Task: Conduct a live demo of your bot
Due

In class on Tuesday, November 25th.

Deliverables

During your 10 minute slot, show off what your bot (and web page) can do.

Turn In

no artifact -- just be present and prepared. The full group should expect to stand up front or otherwise be involved.
